symptoms: Prevention of ischaemic heart disease and atherosclerosis

management_steps.details: Primary prevention: 10 mg at night. Secondary prevention with amlodipine (not on protease inhibitor): 10 to 20 mg at night.
If patient complains of muscle pain, reduce dose (e.g. if 20 mg not tolerated, reduce to 10 mg, or consult specialist).

warnings: Cannot be used with protease inhibitors as protease inhibitors inhibit metabolism resulting in extremely high blood levels.
